fields.name: poster
fields.label: Poster image
fields.description: A path under public/. Also reserves the right space before the video loads.

fields.name: caption
fields.label: Caption
fields.description: Supports markdown, so [links](https://example.com) work.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Note
fields.description: Unused. Tina requires at least one field on a template, and this one has nothing to configure.

fields.label: Bio
fields.name: bio
fields.description: One-line tagline shown under the author name on each post.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in the header and the browser tab.

fields.name: instagram
fields.label: Instagram handle
fields.description: Handle only, no @ and no URL. The button at the bottom opens this account.

fields.name: cta
fields.label: Button at the bottom
fields.description: The one way anyone can reply. Keep it warm and short.

fields.name: chips
fields.label: The basics
fields.description: The row that scrolls sideways at the top of the info card.

fields.name: details
fields.label: More about me
fields.description: The stacked list under the basics.

fields.name: feed
fields.label: The profile
fields.description: Cards render top to bottom in this order. Drag to reorder.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Describe the photo
fields.description: Read aloud by screen readers. Say what is in the picture.

fields.name: caption
fields.label: Hidden caption
fields.description: Stays hidden until someone taps the badge on the photo.

fields.name: focus
fields.label: Keep this part in frame
fields.description: Photos are cropped to fit the card. Pick where the crop holds. Faces near the top usually want Top.

fields.name: shape
fields.label: Shape
fields.description: How tall or wide the card crops the photo.

fields.name: a
fields.label: Answer
fields.description: Line breaks are kept exactly as you type them. Wrap a word in ~~double tildes~~ to strike it out.

fields.name: lead
fields.label: Long answer
fields.description: Sets it in smaller, paragraph-sized type. Use it when the answer is more than a line or two.

fields.name: audio
fields.label: Audio file
fields.description: Optional. Hinge records straight from the mic and gives you no way to export it, so this has to be a fresh recording. Leave it empty and the card shows the words on their own.

fields.name: transcript
fields.label: Transcript
fields.description: Shown under the waveform, for anyone who cannot play audio.

fields.name: poster
fields.label: Still frame
fields.description: Shown before the video loads. Keeps the card from flashing black.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Nothing to fill in
fields.description: This card renders "The basics" and "More about me" from the top of this form. Add it once, wherever you want it to appear.

fields.name: items
fields.label: What they wrote
fields.description: Each one becomes a card in the sideways scroller.

fields.name: by
fields.label: Who said it
fields.description: Written as "Name, how you know them". For example "Penny, Friend".

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Quote
fields.description: The line at the top. Quotation marks are drawn by the page, so leave them out.

fields.name: quoteSource
fields.label: Who said it
fields.description: e.g. Uncle Iroh

fields.name: quoteWork
fields.label: What it is from
fields.description: The linked words after the name, e.g. Avatar: The Last Airbender

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.description: The paragraphs under the quote. Links work here.

fields.name: teas
fields.label: The teas
fields.description: Shown top to bottom in this order. Drag to reorder.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: Which cal.com event
fields.description: Picks the calendar this opens. Set the real times and cafes on cal.com.

fields.name: where
fields.label: Where and when
fields.description: The grey line underneath. Naming the cafes here is just words; cal.com decides what a booker can actually choose.

fields.name: length
fields.label: Length
fields.description: The small label on the right, e.g. 30m. Cosmetic. The real duration is set on cal.com.

fields.name: faqHeading
fields.label: Small print heading
fields.description: The heading above the last section, e.g. "Good to know".

fields.name: faq
fields.label: Small print
fields.description: The short lines at the bottom of the page. Links work here.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
